name: Bluetooth Car FM Transmitter with PD Fast Charger & RGB Light
shortDescription: Play music and take hands-free calls in any car while fast-charging your phone.
description: A car charger that streams your phone's music to the car radio over FM and lets you take hands-free calls with its built-in microphone. USB 3.1A and USB-C ports fast-charge your devices, and a microSD slot plays music directly.
highlights: Bluetooth music to car FM radio

specifications.label: Calling
specifications.value: Built-in microphone with CVC noise cancellation (as advertised)
